milestone_000.title: M0 - Repository & Harness Foundation
milestone_000.description: Prepare the Duelly monorepo for agentic development with independent worktrees, Draft PRs, granular commits, QA evidence, and specialist subagents.

milestone_001.title: M1 - Product Rules & Sports Template System
milestone_001.description: Define and implement the allowed sports template system that prevents free-form betting and only admits objective, binary, deterministic Polymarket-derived markets for the Duelly MVP.

milestone_002.title: M2 - Smart Contract Settlement Core
milestone_002.description: Implement the BRL1-only escrow contract with ERC-2612 funding, EIP-712 bet consent, loserFee settlement, and automatic Polymarket CTF-based resolution.

milestone_003.title: M3 - Backend Core Orchestration, Wallet-First Flow
milestone_003.description: Build the backend required for the MVP using a wallet-first funding model: users bring their own private wallet and BRL1 balance, the backend generates signing payloads, relays valid transactions, indexes contract events, and triggers automatic resolution.

milestone_003_005.title: M3.5 - Platform Wallet, Pix, and Automated BRL1 Operations
milestone_003_005.description: Add the optional platform-managed funding experience after the wallet-first MVP path is working: platform wallet creation, Pix deposit intake through **Inter PJ**, BRL-to-BRL1 purchase automation through **OKX PJ**, BRL1 credit to user wallets, BRL1 sale, fiat withdrawal, brokerage fee accounting, and reconciliation.

milestone_004.title: M4 - Frontend MVP Experience, Wallet-First Flow
milestone_004.description: Deliver the user-facing Duelly flow for the wallet-first MVP. Users log in, connect or verify their own private wallet, use existing BRL1 balance, create and accept 1x1 bets, sign required payloads, and view outcomes without needing to understand smart contracts or gas.

milestone_005.title: M5 - End-to-End MVP Integration, Wallet-First Flow
milestone_005.description: Validate the full Duelly wallet-first flow with frontend, backend, and smart contract running together locally or in staging-like local mode.

milestone_006.title: M6 - Launch Readiness & Controlled Pilot, Wallet-First Flow
milestone_006.description: Prepare the MVP for a controlled pilot using the wallet-first model: participants bring or receive BRL1 in their own private wallets before using Duelly. The pilot can be run with manual/pre-funded BRL1 and does not require Pix, embedded wallets, exchange automation, or M3.5.

m0_t01.description: Apply the approved Duelly bootstrap into the empty GitHub repository.

m1_t00.title: M1.T00 - Establish backend framework foundation for M1
m1_t00.description: Establish the required M1 backend implementation stack:

m1_t01.title: M1.T01 - Finalize sports template acceptance policy and binary market rules
m1_t01.description: State that M1 backend implementation must use Node.js, TypeScript, Fastify, PostgreSQL, and TypeORM.

m1_t02.title: M1.T02 - Capture Polymarket public API configuration and sports fixture strategy
m1_t02.description: Configure Polymarket discovery settings inside the Node.js/TypeScript Fastify backend.

m1_t03.title: M1.T03 - Implement Polymarket sports market discovery adapter
m1_t03.description: Implement the adapter inside the Fastify/TypeScript backend and expose fixture/live discovery endpoints.

m1_t04.title: M1.T04 - Define deterministic sports template schema and templateHash
m1_t04.description: Define TypeScript schema/types for the Fastify backend and TypeORM persistence model for canonical templates.

m1_t05.title: M1.T05 - Implement strict sports template filters and rejection reasons
m1_t05.description: Implement filters as Fastify-accessible backend services and expose accepted/rejected template endpoints.

m1_t06.title: M1.T06 - Specify and stub sports template registry publisher
m1_t06.description: Implement the publisher stub as a Fastify/TypeScript backend module.

m1_t07.title: M1.T07 - Create sports template QA fixture and evidence pack
m1_t07.description: Validate the full M1 backend path through Fastify routes and PostgreSQL/TypeORM persistence where available.

m2_t01.title: M2.T01 - Set up Foundry smart-contract test environment and mocks
m2_t01.description: Initialize or complete Foundry configuration in smartcontract/.

m2_t02.title: M2.T02 - Implement BetEscrowBRL1 contract skeleton and configuration
m2_t02.description: Create BetEscrowBRL1 contract with immutable BRL1 and Polymarket CTF addresses.

m2_t03.title: M2.T03 - Implement EIP-712 BetOffer and BetAcceptance validation
m2_t03.description: Define EIP-712 domain for the escrow contract.

m2_t04.title: M2.T04 - Implement ERC-2612 permit-based atomic funding
m2_t04.description: Implement acceptBetWithPermits or equivalent funding entrypoint.

m2_t05.title: M2.T05 - Implement loserFee formula with gas-anchored minimum
m2_t05.description: Implement on-chain fee validation for `loserFee = max(stake * loserFeeBps / 10_000, minLoserFee)`.

m2_t06.title: M2.T06 - Implement on-chain template registry enforcement
m2_t06.description: Add template registration, deactivation, and lookup functions.

m2_t07.title: M2.T07 - Implement escrow settlement and payout math
m2_t07.description: Implement internal settlement for player A win and player B win.

m2_t08.title: M2.T08 - Implement automatic Polymarket CTF resolution logic

m2_t09.title: M2.T09 - Implement expiry, pause, and security controls
m2_t09.description: Add expiry/void path after resolutionDeadline when CTF resolution is unavailable.

m2_t10.title: M2.T10 - Complete smart-contract QA suite and optional Polygon fork compatibility
m2_t10.description: Organize the full smart-contract test suite into meaningful files.

m3_t01.title: M3.T01 - Create backend service skeleton, configuration, and health checks
m3_t01.description: Create backend app structure inside `backend/` using Node.js, TypeScript, Fastify, PostgreSQL, and TypeORM.

m3_t02.title: M3.T02 - Implement auth, session, and wallet-first user model
m3_t02.description: Implement MVP auth/session model for wallet-first usage.

m3_t03.title: M3.T03 - Implement external wallet linking and ownership verification
m3_t03.description: Implement wallet-linking endpoints for user-owned private wallets.

m3_t04.title: M3.T04 - Implement BRL1 wallet balance and funding-readiness service
m3_t04.description: Implement BRL1 read service for linked external wallets.

m3_t05.title: M3.T05 - Integrate template discovery and template publisher API
m3_t05.description: Expose backend APIs for accepted sports templates produced by M1.

m3_t06.title: M3.T06 - Implement invite, offer, and EIP-712 payload service for private-wallet users
m3_t06.description: Implement invite creation for accepted templates.

m3_t07.title: M3.T07 - Implement loserFee quote and gas-fee-anchored minimum service
m3_t07.description: Implement fee quote endpoint used before invite creation and acceptance.

m3_t08.title: M3.T08 - Implement relayer service for signed wallet-first funding and resolution calls
m3_t08.description: Implement relayer interface for `acceptBetWithPermits` and `resolveFromPolymarket` calls.

m3_t09.title: M3.T09 - Implement contract event indexer and bet state API
m3_t09.description: Index TemplateRegistered, BetFunded, BetResolved, BetVoided, and relevant config events.

m3_t10.title: M3.T10 - Implement resolution trigger and backend curl E2E validation

m3_5_t01.title: M3.5.T01 - Define Inter PJ + OKX PJ architecture, provider policy, and compliance gate
m3_5_t01.description: Document the M3.5 architecture separately from M3.

m3_5_t02.title: M3.5.T02 - Implement auditable ledger and provider interface foundation
m3_5_t02.description: Implement ledger entities and TypeORM migrations for fiat deposits, Inter Pix movements, OKX funding movements, OKX trades, BRL1 withdrawals, wallet credits, BRL1 sells, fiat withdrawals, fees, reversals, and failures.

m3_5_t03.title: M3.5.T03 - Implement platform wallet provider adapter and wallet creation flow

m3_5_t04.title: M3.5.T04 - Implement Inter PJ Pix deposit intake adapter and webhook handling
m3_5_t04.description: Implement `BankingProvider` adapter for Inter PJ Pix deposit intake.

m3_5_t05.title: M3.5.T05 - Implement OKX PJ BRL1 exchange adapter for PoC automation
m3_5_t05.description: Implement exchange adapter interface for OKX PJ market data, balances, internal transfers, spot orders, order status, fills, and BRL1-Polygon withdrawals.

m3_5_t06.title: M3.5.T06 - Implement Inter-to-OKX funding, BRL-to-BRL1 purchase, and platform-wallet credit flow

m3_5_t07.title: M3.5.T07 - Implement BRL1-to-BRL sale and Inter PJ Pix withdrawal flow
m3_5_t07.description: Implement withdrawal quote and request flow.

m3_5_t08.title: M3.5.T08 - Implement fee quotation, reconciliation, and failure recovery
m3_5_t08.description: Implement reconciliation jobs for Inter Pix events, Inter-to-OKX funding events, OKX trades, OKX withdrawals, wallet credits, Inter payouts, and ledger state.

m3_5_t09.title: M3.5.T09 - Implement optional platform-wallet deposit/withdraw frontend experience
m3_5_t09.description: Add optional UI path for platform wallet creation.
